title: Redis budget window must carry and match the duration that produced its bounds
answers: budget policy edited to a new duration still gives 429 with the old window
Redis budget window stuck on monthly bounds after switching to daily limit
gateway processes disagree on budget window after policy duration change
wrong daily limit message 429 resets a month out
body:
Symptom: After a budget policy's duration is edited (e.g. 1 MONTHS/$500 to 1 DAYS/$100), requests are rejected with HTTP 429 against a window spanning a month, and the message quotes a daily limit resetting far away.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py:_ENSURE_WINDOW_LUA compared only window_start, and RedisBudgetTracker.should_reject_request evaluated any stored window against the local policy, so a process on an older policy version rewrote bounds the newer version then measured against its own limit.
Fix pattern: Store duration_unit and duration_value in the window hash alongside the bounds. _ENSURE_WINDOW_LUA rolls the window when either field differs from the applied policy, and should_reject_request skips a window whose duration fails _window_duration_matches, the same way it skips an ended window.
Constraints: Windows with no duration fields roll once on upgrade and are reseeded from trace history by maybe_refresh_budget_policies. Comparing window_start alone is insufficient because a monthly and a daily window can begin at the same instant (1st of a month). Brief cross-process disagreement can still under-count spend for one refresh interval; this is accepted as fail-open.
applies: Any change to RedisBudgetTracker window creation, rollover, or rejection logic in mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py.
says: Changing our budget policy to daily still blocks requests until next month.
The gateway rate limit error says our daily spending cap resets weeks away.
Switching spend limits from monthly to daily should reset our quota window immediately.
After updating budget duration, API calls fail with the previous period rate limit.
Ensure gateway spend limits honor newly edited billing cycles instead of old bounds.
search: Redis budget tracking window management in mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py must store duration_unit and duration_value in the window hash so _ENSURE_WINDOW_LUA rolls windows when policy duration changes and RedisBudgetTracker.should_reject_request skips windows failing _window_duration_matches. Applies to changes in RedisBudgetTracker window creation, rollover, or rejection logic, where checking window_start alone is insufficient because different durations can share start timestamps. Legacy windows missing duration fields roll once on upgrade and are reseeded by maybe_refresh_budget_policies, tolerating brief cross-process under-counts as fail-open.
